summary_en: K.U. Holdings authorized the acquisition of up to 1 million shares, or 3.2% of outstanding shares, for a maximum of 1.3 billion yen via market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 16 to December 30, 2026, to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: K.U. Holdings authorized the acquisition of treasury shares to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. The company will acquire up to 1 million ordinary shares, representing 3.2% of outstanding shares, for a maximum total of 1.3 billion yen. The acquisition will be executed via market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, including off-auction purchases, during the period from November 16, 2026 through December 30, 2026. As of October 31, 2026, the company held 12.45 million treasury shares against total issued shares of 44.13 million (including self-held shares).
